title: Release audit: On a successful check, `bounded_run` clears `CHECK_CHILD` before `cleanup_check`
summary: Run the checked shell in its own process group/session (with stdin/stdout detached so an interactive shell does not stop) and terminate that group after every outcome, including success; otherwise reliably enumerate and kill descendants before clearing `CHECK_CHILD`. Add a test with a profile that starts a background process.
requirements: On a successful check, `bounded_run` clears `CHECK_CHILD` before `cleanup_check` and never signals the checked login shell's process group or descendants. A profile that starts a background process leaves that process running after the check, contrary to the requirement that no process started by the check remains. The timeout path also relies on a process-tree walk and does not preserve a dedicated group for cleanup.
